questions.stem: Which of the following is a use of silver nanoparticles?

options.text: Killing bacteria in antibacterial coatings and clothing

questions.explanation: Silver nanoparticles are used for their antibacterial properties. They can kill bacteria and are incorporated into products such as antibacterial clothing, wound dressings, and coatings. Their high surface area to volume ratio makes them particularly effective at this nanoscale.
